comparability.plotAreaDifference: C0 has 588 DIP plot height; C1 v2 has 582 DIP. Both nominal chart sizes are 1200x650 DIP and plot widths are 1054 DIP. This 6 DIP layout difference is recorded rather than claimed to be pixel-identical quality.
comparability.stageInterpretation: C1 observation/materialization work moves into sourceApply; scenePrepare additionally projects immutable data. Compare sourceApply, scenePrepare and firstUsableToRecord together, not scenePrepare alone.

findings: C1 has substantial diagnostic regressions at large scale; S1M-L scenePrepare p95=154.032ms, hitQuery p95=45.4544ms and observed process private memory=1075556352 bytes. These values must remain visible and drive C4 work.
S1M-L render-record p95=44.8471ms and sourceApply p95=167.4765ms; render-record is not render completion, framePipeline, present or achieved FPS.
SourceApply/scenePrepare costs include the new C1 immutable projection/identity/data contract. Correctness passing does not imply performance acceptance.
Later small scenarios execute after S1M-L in the same process; their high private memory is affected by retained allocator/GC state and cannot be attributed solely to their datasets.
limitations: One process per report, fixed scenario order, one warmup and only two measured samples per scene. Scene p95 is therefore the maximum of two values; hit p95 uses ten queries across those samples.
No randomized/ABBA run order, five-process distribution, full corpus, confidence interval, isolated per-scene process, steady-state memory/CPU trace, or peak private-memory sampler.
Memory is process before/after observation, including earlier scenarios and GC/allocator effects; it is not an isolated control allocation or continuous private peak.
Headless DrawingGroup recording has no GPU/compositor/present evidence. framePipelineMs, submitMs and presentMs remain null/blocked-present.
No licensed same-host official reference. Reference ratios are blocked-reference; the numeric C1/C0 diagnostic ratios do not evaluate the 1.25x official-reference target.
S-RT-POC is small batch replacement, not paced 10000-points/s, a 30-minute/8-hour soak, or a bounded ring-buffer qualification.
Actual plot height changed by 6 DIP. The nominal profile and measurement sources match, but strict same-pixel rendering quality equivalence has not been established.
